name: Knight · Ember
description: The Ember Knight: a hot-headed young knight forged in a volcano. A blackened-brass sallet with a living flame for a crest and two big glowing eyes, crimson plate cracked with glowing seams, a scorched half-cape and no shield, one broad flamberge whose edges glow ember-orange, carried low and forward with a swagger. His cut rears the blade back over the helm, brings it over in a blazing crescent that leaves sparks, sweeps it down in front and recovers.
